title: alepidea ciliaris var. serrata
intro: Alepidea ciliaris var. serrata, commonly known as the serrated mountain helichrysum, is a plant species in the family Melanthiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The serrated mountain helichrysum is reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving pain, and exhibiting antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids.
